title: Core: AS2 anonymous function and closure compilation
description: Verify AS2 anonymous functions and closures compile: var f = function(x) { return x * 2; }, immediately-invoked (function(){})(), closures that capture outer variables, function as argument, return function from function. Verify ActionDefineFunction2 (0x8E) is emitted. Tests in packages/core/src/as2/__tests__/closures.test.ts.
